spanish: Y le dijo Edom: No pasarás por mí, no sea que con espada salga a tu encuentro.

findings.issue: בַּחֶרֶב is preposition plus definite article plus singular sword (HRd/Ncfsa); Spanish bare “espada” keeps the instrument and drops the article as smoothing.

notes: Clause matches: Edom tells him he will not pass through him, lest he go out with the sword to meet him.
